Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Pelan Tempatan

Kuala Lumpur 2040) 2025.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 11 Jun 2025.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan Pelan Tempatan Kuala Lumpur 2040 hendaklah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Pertama.

Pembatalan

3. Kaedah-Kaedah bagi fi untuk pembelian pelan tempatan sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kedua dibatalkan.

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF

KUALA LUMPUR LOCAL PLAN 2040) RULES 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 16, 17 and paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner,

with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)

(Fee for Purchase of Kuala Lumpur Local Plan 2040) Rules 2025.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 11 June 2025.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the Kuala Lumpur Local Plan 2040 shall be

as specified in the First Schedule.

Revocation

3. Rules for fee of purchase of local plan as specified in the Second Schedule

are revoked.

FIRST SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(RM)

(a) in the national language

(i) hard copy 250.00

(ii) electronic form 100.00
